title: Shetti suspends sugarcane stir after admin agrees to stop harvesting till Nov 19

ai.summary: SSS founder Raju Shetti temporarily suspended a sugarcane farmers' sit-in protest in Solapur after district administration agreed to stop harvesting until November 19 and hold a meeting with sugar mill owners to discuss ₹3,500 per tonne payment.

facts.claim: SSS founder and former MP Raju Shetti temporarily suspended the sit-in protest in Solapur after the district administration agreed to stop sugarcane harvesting till November 19
facts.quote: SSS founder and former MP Raju Shetti on Tuesday temporarily suspended the sit-in protest started by him in Solapur after the district administration agreed to stop sugarcane harvesting across the district till November 19

facts.claim: The protest was called off after midnight on Monday following intervention by senior district officials and a written communication from collector S Karthikeyan who visited the protest site and handed over the letter to Shetti
facts.quote: The protest was called off after midnight on Monday following intervention by senior district officials and a written communication from collector S Karthikeyan who visited the protest site and handed over the letter to Shetti

facts.claim: Hundreds of farmers, led by Shetti, had begun a sit-in protest outside the new collector’s office at Sat Rasta on Monday. The protesters demanded that sugarcane harvesting be stopped across the district till such time a final decision is taken on the purchase price
facts.quote: Hundreds of farmers, led by Shetti, had begun a sit-in protest outside the new collector’s office at Sat Rasta on Monday. The protesters demanded that sugarcane harvesting be stopped across the district till such time a final decision is taken on the purchase price

facts.claim: The agitation had begun with a march from the Hutatma Smarak area, in which farmers from across Solapur district participated
facts.quote: The agitation had begun with a march from the Hutatma Smarak area, in which farmers from across Solapur district participated

facts.claim: Following the intervention, Shetti said that the agitation has been temporarily suspended after the administration gave a written assurance about suspending sugarcane harvesting and about calling a meeting of chairpersons of all sugar factories in the district at 11 am on November 19 at the collector’s office
facts.quote: Following the intervention, Shetti said that the agitation has been temporarily suspended after the administration gave a written assurance about suspending sugarcane harvesting and about calling a meeting of chairpersons of all sugar factories in the district at 11 am on November 19 at the collector’s office

facts.claim: If a positive decision is not taken at the November 19 meeting regarding our demand for a first payment of ₹3,500 per tonne, we will launch an even more intense agitation
facts.quote: If a positive decision is not taken at the November 19 meeting regarding our demand for a first payment of ₹3,500 per tonne, we will launch an even more intense agitation

ai.background_note: SSS farmers in Solapur district demanded ₹3,500 per tonne for sugarcane after transport costs, but state offered ₹3,300.
